name: Rockjumper Birding Tours

conservation.detail: A minimum of US$50 from every tour sign-up goes to the Rockjumper Bird Conservation Fund, running since 2006, with major grants to BirdLife International including the White-winged Flufftail programme.

blurb: One of the largest dedicated birding tour companies in the world, running scheduled and custom tours on every continent with a conservation fund built into every booking.

name: Birding Ecotours

conservation.detail: Donates a minimum of 10% of annual company profits to bird conservation and disadvantaged local communities, including wetland restoration around Lake Victoria and reforestation in the Albertine Rift.

blurb: Worldwide small-group and custom birding tours with one of the strongest published giving policies in the industry.

name: Naturetrek

conservation.detail: Holds AITO's top 5-star sustainable tourism accreditation, runs its HQ on renewable energy and funds habitat protection with Fundacion EcoMinga in Ecuador as its carbon retention partner.

blurb: The UK's largest specialist wildlife and birding tour operator, with four decades of expert-led natural history holidays across the globe.

name: Eagle-Eye Tours

conservation.detail: Member of 1% for the Planet, giving 1% of sales to conservation, and certified Carbonfree by Carbonfund.org covering flights, vehicles, ships and office energy. Tours directly support Birds Canada, American Bird Conservancy and BirdLife Australia.

blurb: Canadian birding specialist running small-group tours worldwide, carbon neutral across the whole business and giving one percent of sales to conservation.

name: Partnership for International Birding

conservation.detail: Sets aside US$100 per booking for bird conservation and commits over 10% of company effort to conservation work, with formal partnerships with Rainforest Trust and World Land Trust.

blurb: Connects birders with vetted local guides and lodges around the world, channelling a fixed conservation contribution from every booking into land protection.

name: Cheesemans' Ecology Safaris

conservation.detail: Carbon neutral since 2022 through verified offset partnerships, provided founding funding for the Happywhale citizen science platform and builds iNaturalist recording into its expeditions.

blurb: Expedition-style wildlife and birding safaris with a citizen science backbone, from Antarctica to the Pantanal.

name: Field Guides Birding Tours

conservation.detail: Makes documented end-of-year contributions to BirdLife International, Conservation International, The Nature Conservancy, BirdsCaribbean and American Bird Conservancy.

blurb: Guide-owned birding tour company running expert-led tours across the Americas and beyond since 1985.

name: Inala Nature Tours

conservation.detail: Operates from a 1,500 acre private conservation refuge protecting six threatened species and all twelve Tasmanian endemics, and funds habitat regeneration through the Inala Foundation. BirdLife Australia partner.

blurb: Tasmanian birding tours run from a private reserve where every endemic in the state can be found, with a foundation restoring habitat on the ground.

name: Birdquest
blurb: Legendary for depth of coverage, with the biggest life list of any tour company and pioneering itineraries to the world's least birded corners.

name: Victor Emanuel Nature Tours
blurb: One of the longest running birding tour companies in the Americas, known for legendary leaders and a youth scholarship programme that has launched generations of birders.

name: WINGS Birding Tours
blurb: Worldwide birding tours led by career field ornithologists, with a catalogue that now includes the historic Sunbird programme.

name: Tropical Birding
blurb: Ecuador-based specialists famous for set-departure and custom tours across the tropics, plus photography-focused birding trips.

name: WildWings
blurb: UK wildlife travel company covering birding tours and expedition cruises, and a longtime conservation sponsor of the Global Birdfair.

name: Ornitholidays
blurb: Britain's original birdwatching holiday company, running escorted small-group tours since 1965.

name: Limosa Holidays
blurb: Norfolk-based birding tour specialist and a longtime conservation sponsor of the Global Birdfair.

name: Heatherlea
blurb: Scottish Highlands birding specialist running guided holidays from its own Speyside base, plus worldwide departures.

name: Bird Treks
blurb: Small-group birding tours across the Americas and beyond, built around slow-paced field time.

name: Wild About Colombia
blurb: Locally owned Colombian company running small-group and custom birding tours across the world's richest bird country.

name: Manu Expeditions
blurb: Pioneer ecotourism operator in the Manu region, founded by ornithologist Barry Walker and running birding and wildlife expeditions from Cusco for four decades.

name: Naturalist Journeys
blurb: Nature and birding tours worldwide with a naturalist-led, whole-ecosystem approach.

name: Wildside Nature Tours
blurb: Birding and wildlife tours worldwide, including exclusive-access trips run with the Jocotoco Conservation Foundation in Ecuador.

name: Peregrine Bird Tours
blurb: Australian birding tour company and official BirdLife Australia partner, running tours at home and abroad.
